name: check-if-email-exists
summary: Rust crate, CLI and Docker HTTP backend that checks if an email address exists without sending any email.
description: Validates an address end to end: syntax, MX records, SMTP connection, deliverability, disabled mailbox, full inbox, catch-all, disposable and role accounts, Gravatar and Have I Been Pwned breaches. Use it as a Rust crate, a standalone CLI binary, or a Docker HTTP backend answering POST /v0/check_email with JSON fields such as is_reachable and smtp.is_deliverable.
contains: 12 checks: syntax, MX, SMTP connect, deliverability, disabled, full inbox, catch-all, disposable, role account, breach
3 ways to run: Docker HTTP backend, CLI binary, Rust crate
JSON output per check (is_reachable, syntax.is_valid_syntax, mx.accepts_mail, smtp.is_deliverable ...)
HTTP backend needs outbound port 25 open; SMTP proxies recommended beyond small volumes
live demo at reacher.email; a paid SaaS version exists separately
